title: Cybernetic Tree Entity
description: A massive mechanical tree-like entity with a metallic mask face dominates the center. It features glowing green circuit eyes, a jagged white grin, branching dark limbs with glowing orange circuitry, and hanging crystalline droplets against a starry blue and green cosmic background.
prompt: A surreal cybernetic tree entity growing from a canyon, featuring a large metallic mask with intense glowing green circuit eyes and a wide jagged white grin, dark gnarled branches filled with orange glowing circuitry patterns extending into a starry sky, crystalline droplets hanging from the branches, roots and circuits visible in the rocky cliffs below, cosmic green and blue nebula background, highly detailed digital painting
